CONSTANT = 1


@decorator
def decorated_function(a, b):
    """Has a decorator on the line above."""
    return a + b


async def async_top_level(x):
    await x


class Outer:
    """Class docstring."""

    attribute = 2

    @property
    def one_liner(self):
        return self.attribute

    @staticmethod
    def tiny():
        return 1

    async def async_method(self, x):
        return await x

    class Nested:
        """Nested class docstring."""

        nested_attr = 3

        def nested_method(self):
            return self.nested_attr
